values := [27, 64, 13, 88, 41, 5, 72, 36]
swaps := 0
for: 1 <= pass <= 7
    changed := false
    for: j <= 7 - pass
        if values[j] > values[j + 1]
            values[j], values[j + 1] = values[j + 1], values[j]
            swaps += 1
            changed = true
    println("pass {pass}: {text.join(values, " ")}")
    if not changed
        break
println("swaps: {swaps}")
